demo.title: onchain-forensics-check.sh
demo.code:
# Free first check of the day: is this token actually alive?
curl -s "https://solene-fa2010da.base44.app/functions/verdictFast?address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&chain=base"

# Free developer key: 10,000 cached checks per month, no card
curl -s -X POST "https://solene-fa2010da.base44.app/functions/devKeys" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"email":"you@example.com"}'

# Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base, a Bankr wallet settles it)
npx awal x402 pay "https://solene-fa2010da.base44.app/functions/forensicsVerdict?address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006&chain=base"

# Or run it as an MCP server
npx -y github:leohoudinisanders-byte/forensics-mcp

setup: Optional: set `FORENSICS_DEV_KEY` to a free key for 10,000 cached checks per month (mint one at POST /functions/devKeys with an email)
Or pay per request over x402 in USDC on Base — the 402 challenge carries price, asset, payTo and network
Fastest path to a working tool: `npx -y github:leohoudinisanders-byte/forensics-mcp` and set `FORENSICS_DEV_KEY`
Cached verdict is $0.001, live verdict and settlement safety $0.02, wallet and token profile $0.05, batch screening $1 per 25 tokens
